## Content
SUNNY Chinese critical continuation, 2026-11-03 UTC. Owned report: docs/research/reactivation-chinese.md; checkpoint08 and evidence in state/research/reactivation/chinese/. Actual Jev1.14 selected the minimal obstruction test (0.62) and conditional reuse (0.73); full receipts retained. The one-context fixed-offset adapter fails three equations with residue4 mod12, independent of common origin, global reversal or octave lift. The positive surviving interpretation is prior art: received Zhuzi Yulei92 and Hu Yansheng's Yue lü biao wei treat listed terms as separate pieces/modes; Hegesh2025 pp163–164 notes60–61 discusses the same alternative and historical uncertainty. Conditional operator g=p−d(role) mod12 removes only one shared gong context for all roles in a ritual row, while retaining standard identity and fixed offsets within each piece. With arbitrary alpha, implicit-gong rows are heaven alpha+[3,8,7,7], earth alpha+[7,10,9,0], ancestors alpha+[0,9,7,2]. All144 row/origin checks pass. Four ancestral assignments also have exact ideal relative-frequency lifts with octave exponents[0,−1,−1,0]; no absoluteHz or measured pipe calibration is claimed. Full12 exact acoustic lift stays withheld; optional ideal comma residuals and literalYize denominator727 versus ideal729 are explicit. Nine verification groups passed; actual Wolfram checked the obstruction and ancestral positive/rational family, and Proofline verified3 source packages/7 commentary spans (integrity only). P0-A14 delta remains scholarly/open, noM1–M12 or blind prediction. Preserve Zheng/Jia's competing generation/exclusion/coarseness reading and mode-versus-tone distinction. Neither historical original intention nor language glyph/sound mapping is solved. CompletedHarmony, Fludd–Kepler/monochord and TOL ABBA remain held aside in this experiment, not deleted. Root owns shared executable integration; no shared files or runtime changed by this lane.
